chapter_note: Chapter is fivefold cosmological teaching about Peace/Right Hand/Embrace/Obeisance/Ordination — mapping First Man's cosmic drama. Strong substrate core in segments 14-101 with the dual sequence (cosmic First Man → application among men). Editorial fatigue clearly visible: second half drifts heavily into Manichaean Ecclesial vocabulary (Church, Faith, elect, teachers/bishops/presbyters) and hortatory address. The "second" iteration of each mystery becomes a hinge where editor applies cosmic pattern to contemporary church ritual. Significant manuscript damage (45.9%).
